channel.title: gameformative — latest articles
channel.description: gameformative — sport analysis and education: news, tactics, techniques and the science of sport, every article with its sources listed, used and investigated.

item.title: Your GPS says “injury risk.” The new football evidence says: which math are we using?
item.description: Your GPS watch says the team is “overcooked.” The medical staff hears “injury risk.” But a 2026 football review found something awkward: depending on how researchers cut…

item.title: Five from five: what Man City’s perfect start does — and doesn’t — tell us
item.description: 15 points from 5 matches is the best start in the league. Last season, the team with 15 after five finished fifth.

item.title: Europe’s big five after a month: the Bundesliga scores most, the Premier League draws most
item.description: 3.81 goals a game in Germany, 2.82 in England — and not a single goalless draw yet in Serie A.

item.title: How Spain won the 2026 World Cup: 14 scored, 1 conceded
item.description: Eight matches, one goal against, and a final settled in extra time by a substitute. The tournament in numbers.

item.title: One goal in four came after the 75th minute: the 2025/26 Premier League by the clock
item.description: 270 of 1,045 goals arrived in the last quarter-hour of normal time, more than twice as many as in the first fifteen minutes.

item.title: Points per game, goal difference and form: how to read a table in September
item.description: Leagues that have played different numbers of rounds, teams with a game in hand, a run of five results — three tools for reading a table before it settles.
